ColoringModel.title: ColoringModel
ColoringModel.description: Approved model showcase photograph for one of the 26 coloring techniques.

techniqueId.description: Catalog identifier matching one of the 26 coloring techniques.

imageDataUrl.description: Compressed JPEG data URL for the approved model photograph.

promptUsed.description: Prompt notes or upload label describing the look.

isPublished.description: Whether this model photo is publicly visible in the catalog.

approvedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the master stylist who approved the photo.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was first published.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest photo approval.

AdminMember.title: AdminMember
AdminMember.description: Authorized master stylist account allowed to publish model photos.

/coloring_models/{techniqueId}.description: Publicly readable approved model photos for coloring techniques; writable only by verified master admins.

/haircut_models/{haircutId}.description: Publicly readable approved model photos for haircut forms; writable only by verified master admins.

/care_models/{careId}.description: Publicly readable approved showcase photos for spa haircare treatments; writable only by verified master admins.

/styling_models/{stylingId}.description: Publicly readable approved showcase photos for salon hairstyles and styling looks; writable only by verified master admins.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Registry of authorized master stylist UIDs.
